title: Munsi y'igitutu c'umusukoni
intro: Inkuru ivuga ivy’umutima washizwe ku ruhande imbere y’uko uvuka, ugaburirwa mu bihome vyeranda, ugatoranywa kugira ngo ushire ikimenyetso isi itari bwigere ibona. Igihe ikirego cava mu mpande zose, ijwi ryava ahantu hatashoboka cane kugira ngo riceceke amakenga yose. Woba ushobora kumenya uwagendeye munsi y’igitutu c’ico giti c’umusukoni?
clues: Nari niyemeje gukorera Ishoboravyose imbere y’uko nsubira guhumeka ubwa mbere, indagano yatanzwe n’uwantwaye.
Nakuriye mu kwitwararikwa n’umurinzi w’umugororotsi mu vyumba vyeranda vy’ahantu ho gusengera.
Igihe cose uwujejwe kuncungera yaza mu cumba canje, yasanga ndi kumwe n’ibifungurwa vyo mu bihe vy’umwaka bitari bikwiye kubaho.
Nararonse inkuru nziza y’umuhungu, naho nyene ivyanje vyari bitasigaye ikibanza c’ivyo nari narasezeranye.
Naciye nsubira inyuma nja ahantu kure, maze ng’aho igiti c’umusukoni campa igitutu mu gihe umugezi wariko uratemba munsi.
Igihe ikirego caza kandi ibibazo bikankikuza, narerekanye umwana wanje aherutse kuvuka — aca avuga ari mu nda kugira ngo acereze amakenga yose.
